name: Credit counselor

google_prefill.phone: [G] the listed phone (stays the business's; customers use Rosie's one number)

A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: First session
services.story: The main story: a $35 first budget session at the office. Nothing is taken when Alex books; Alex pays at the desk after the session.

services.name: First session
services.story: The same $35 session at the office, with a card saved for the $20 late-cancel or no-show fee. Alex pays at the desk.

services.name: First session by video
services.story: A $35 budget session by video, with a card saved. The card is charged $35 when the counselor texts DONE.

services.name: Three-session budget package
services.story: The three-session budget package: $150, paid in full when booked. Each session uses one of the three.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Budgets setup visit
services.story: The main story: a $179 budgets setup visit at home. Nothing is taken when booked. Rosie texts the bill after the visit.

services.name: Budgets setup visit
services.story: The same $179 visit, with a card saved for the $89 visit fee. The bill is texted after the visit.

services.name: Budgets cleanup
services.story: A household budget cleanup at home, priced from the documents at $240. The owner OKs it. A card is saved for the $40 fee, and the bill is texted after the review.

questions_before_times: Which counselor? The client names one, or sees the agency's counselors listed with no ranking.
What's the goal, in a few words: a budget, a plan for debts, or a question about a bill? No amounts, creditor names or account numbers in the chat.
At the office, by video or phone, or at your home (flow B)?
A single session, the three-session package, or a follow-up?
New or returning client? A new client starts with the intake and the counseling agreement.
safety_stop: someone says they may hurt themselves or someone else
danger right now, or a medical emergency
an overdose, or swallowed medicine or a chemical
someone says they'll be hurt or made to pay by a person in their home, or they're afraid to go home over money
license: None by default: counseling needs no state license for a budget session. Where a state's form names a registration for debt counseling or a debt-management service, it is a switch and the owner adds it. The counselor's own certificate is shown as the counselor's word.
staff_skills: ["Budget counseling","Debt plans (explained, not sold)","Home budget visits"]
messages_never: ["anything the client shares about money: income, bills, debts, a creditor, a balance, a late payment or a loss","what was said in a session","why a booking was declined","crisis words or a safety answer"]
